content:
Owen Wilson stars in comedy Stick and shares many heartwarming similarities with Ted Lasso — Apple has just announced Stick is coming back for a second season, with Pluribus star Rhea Seehorn joining the cast.

Stick Season 2 premieres November 4, with Rhea Seehorn joining the cast

After the Season 3 finale of Ted Lasso, no one knew if the show would return. Lasso fans are in luck — the show really is coming back, and Season 4 is now airing.

But during Lasso's absence, Apple TV launched a new show with a very similar vibe to Lasso.

Owen Wilson's Stick premiered last summer and was immediately compared to Ted Lasso, seen as another warm and feel-good sports comedy. And shortly after Lasso's Season 4 wraps up, Stick will be returning.

Stick Season 2 will premiere its first two episodes on Wednesday, November 4, followed by weekly new episodes through December 30.

Here's the synopsis provided by Apple (spoiler-free):

According to Apple's press release, the new season will see Santi pursuing the next step toward the professional golf tour, while Pryce also returns to the course.

Stick's strong ensemble cast is all back for Season 2, including Wilson along with Peter Dager, Marc Maron, Mariana Treviño, Lilli Kay, Judy Greer, and Timothy Olyphant.

Pluribus star Rhea Seehorn joins the cast as Pryce's new golf coach. Other new additions include John Higgins, Billy Zane, Rex Linn, Sasha Alexander, and Missi Pyle.

You can catch up on Stick Season 1 on Apple TV.

Are you a Stick fan planning to watch Season 2? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, or you can bundle it for a discount through Apple One.
